propositions: AGENTS.md and .agents/rules/rebar.md currently prescribe a hardcoded bot identity (joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com) for all contributors, contradicting CONTRIBUTING.md which requires real configured identities
Contributor guidance must be updated to instruct all actors to sign off with their own git config user.name and user.email instead of a specific maintainer identity

A deterministic lint-integrated grep check must be added to fail the build if hardcoded bot identities reappear in contributor-facing guidance files (AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/*.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/**/*.md), while explicitly excluding automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/, docs/experiments/)
Joe Oakhart bot identity should be retained only in narrowly scoped automation guidance and automation-owned paths, not in general contributor-facing documentation
